description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding in the rear garden of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2018/113HH - 05  Received:  05 June 2019; 2018/113HH - 07  Received:  10 June 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for the purposes shown in the approved drawings or for other purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 29 Kingsbridge Road, UB2 5RT as a single family house, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
Condition : 5 - 5		The materials used in the development hereby approved shall be red/brown sandfaced brickwork, white door and window frames and red concrete or clay roof tiles
